title: schorm Course (course.yml)
description: The course.yml file at a schorm project root: course metadata plus the ordered list of modules and their items. Rules the schema cannot express, which generated courses MUST still follow: (1) every entry in a module's 'items' must be the id of a lesson markdown file (content/<module-id>/*.md frontmatter 'id') or a quiz YAML file (quizzes/**.yml 'id'); (2) 'sequencing.gate.quiz' must be one of that module's items; (3) branch/choice 'start', 'from' and route 'to' values must reference that module's items; (4) a branch's 'choices' entries must reference declared choice ids; (5) branch and choice ids must be unique within the module; (6) conditional routes must not form cycles (e.g. a -> b -> a is rejected).

id.description: Unique course identifier: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only. Used in the SCORM manifest and the default package filename.

title.description: Human-readable course title, shown in the LMS and on every page.

metadata.description: Optional course metadata. NOTE: 'description' must live here, not at the top level of course.yml - a top-level 'description' key is ignored.

description.description: Course description, shown on the generated index page.

duration.description: Estimated course duration in minutes. Informational.

modules.description: The course modules, in display order.

id.description: Module identifier, unique within the course. Lesson files for this module live in content/<module-id>/ and quizzes in quizzes/<module-id>/ (or quizzes/).

items.description: Ordered ids of the lessons and quizzes in this module. Each id MUST match the 'id' in a lesson's frontmatter or a quiz file. In scenario mode this list is ignored and auto-generated from the scene files.

moduleSequencing.description: Optional navigation and branching rules for the module, converted into SCORM 2004 sequencing in the manifest.

mode.description: Navigation mode. 'linear' forces chronological order, 'free' (default) allows any order, 'scenario' builds a choose-your-own-adventure graph from linked markdown scene files (requires 'scenario.start'; 'items', 'branches' and 'choices' are then ignored and auto-generated).

quiz.description: Id of a quiz in this module's 'items'. Items after the gate stay disabled in the LMS until this quiz is passed.

gate.description: Lock later items until a quiz is passed.

branches.description: Named entry points into the navigation graph. EXPERIMENTAL together with 'choices': conditional routes read course variables that the current runtime provides no supported way to set.

choices.description: Conditional jump rules between items. EXPERIMENTAL: see 'branches'.

start.description: Filename of the first scene markdown file (relative to the module's content directory), e.g. "start.md".

contentDir.description: Base content directory. Scene files are read from <contentDir>/<module-id>/.

scenario.description: Scenario-mode configuration. Required when mode is 'scenario'.

id.description: Branch identifier, unique within the module.

start.description: Id of the item where this branch begins. MUST be one of the module's 'items'.

choices.description: Ids of choices (from the module's 'choices' array) reachable on this branch.

id.description: Choice identifier, unique within the module.

from.description: Id of the item where this choice is presented. MUST be one of the module's 'items'.

routes.description: The possible destinations. Routes with conditions are evaluated in order; at most one should match.

to.description: Id of the destination item. MUST be one of the module's 'items'. Required unless 'end' is true.

end.description: When true, taking this route exits the flow instead of jumping to another item. Either 'to' or 'end: true' must be present.

variable.description: Name of the course variable to compare (e.g. "learner.role"). EXPERIMENTAL: the current runtime provides no supported way to set course variables.

branchCondition.description: A comparison against a course variable. At least one of 'equals', 'notEquals', 'in' or 'notIn' must be present.

scalar.description: A string, number or boolean value.
